name: Study of the Elements: Rock
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, you've already proven more able than all my apprentices combined.

The next parts I need require a little more strength. Large stone slabs can be found on rock elementals if you're careful enough. Their bodies are stronger and larger, and therefore more prone to having pieces large enough for my tests. You can find them further west of here or southeast along the mountains' edges.

Take your time; I'll need a while to test these smaller pieces you brought me.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Large Stone Slabs to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: adventurer, simply amazing! I would have thought it'd take half a dozen tauren to bring all these to me.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm most pleased, adventurer. My spells affected the smaller pieces just as I predicted. If this experiment is as successful as I foresee, then the elementals I'll be able to control will put anything summoned prior to this to shame.
